title: rangaeris trachypus
intro: Rangaeris trachypus, commonly known as the "Red and Yellow Rangaeris", is a species of orchid found in tropical Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and snake bites. Rangaeris trachypus is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rangaeris trachypus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
